title: Licensing & Hardware Affinity Matrix for Enterprise Model Selection
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Build an actionable matrix that maps model licensing constraints, per-region hardware affinity, and estimated total cost of ownership (TCO) for enterprise procurement teams. The matrix should enable sales and solutions engineers to determine recommended model variants by customer profile (regulated vs cloud-first, latency sensitivity, and committed spend). Deliverables: 1) CSV matrix and lookup API, 2) Confluence decision guide, 3) sample sales playbook snippets and a short dashboard for quick adjudication during procurement calls.
acceptance_criteria: CSV matrix with rows for ~40 production-ready model variants and columns for license type, commercial constraints, allowable deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), preferred hardware families (A100/H100/TPU/CPU quantized), and estimated token cost delta
Lookup API endpoint (internal) that returns ranked model recommendations given customer constraints
Confluence guide with clear decision trees and 3 real-customer worked examples
Sign-off from Legal on license interpretations and from Infra on hardware recommendations
decisions: Use a three-tier license classification (Open, Permissive Commercial, Restricted Commercial) to simplify procurement conversations
Hardware affinity will be expressed as primary + fallback families rather than exact SKU to reduce churn during capacity planning
Initial scope limited to models already validated in our runtime-compatibility test-suite to avoid inclusion of unverified variants
